datasets.title: IOM Bangladesh - Needs and Population Monitoring (NPM) Drone imagery and GIS package by camp (June 2018)
datasets.description: NPM Bangladesh has produced a number of tools based on its regular data collection activities and drone flights. The package of June 2018 is based on NPM Baseline Assessment 11 (as of 14 June) and NPM most updated drone imagery (as of 21 June). Here below, the complete package by camp: SW Map package KMZ file Drone image The full image and shapefiles are available at this link .. [Source: This metadata record was automatically extracted from the Humanitarian Data Exchange (HDX); Original dataset: https://data.humdata.org/dataset/iom-bangladesh-needs-and-population-monitoring-npm-drone-imagery-and-gis-package-by-camp-june-2018]

lineage.description: IOM conducted direct observational data collection through drone flights (as of 21 June 2018) and baseline needs assessments (as of 14 June 2018) across refugee camps in Cox's Bazar, Bangladesh. Spatial data was processed into KML/shapefile format organized by individual camp to document population distribution and settlement structure inventory.

sources.name: International Organization for Migration (IOM)
sources.description: Direct observational data from drone flights and field assessments documenting refugee camp populations and shelter infrastructure as of June 2018
